tools.Name: SAM 3
tools.Description: A unified foundation model for promptable segmentation in images and videos, capable of segmenting open-vocabulary concepts using text or visual prompts.
tools.Use_Case: Automated object detection, tracking, and instance segmentation in images and video streams.

tools.Name: Scrapling
tools.Description: An adaptive, high-performance web scraping framework that uses AI to maintain element selection even when website structures change.
tools.Use_Case: Building robust, anti-bot resistant web crawlers and scraping pipelines that survive UI changes.

tools.Name: Fooocus
tools.Description: An offline, open-source image generation tool based on Stable Diffusion XL that emphasizes user prompt-centric generation over complex parameter tuning.
tools.Use_Case: Generating high-quality images locally without needing deep expertise in prompt engineering or technical model settings.
